title: On Killing the bird with a single stone
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：kill　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kill 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the engineer ① killed the bird with a single stone before dawn, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② kills the bird with a single stone in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ kill the bird with a single stone at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ killed the bird with a single stone before — a line in the manual for April 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Killing the bird with a single stone before dawn, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ kill an hour in the empty station in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Kill an hour in the empty station at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ kills an hour in the empty station before dawn every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ killed the bird with a single stone again when nobody else would.

⑩ To kill the bird with a single stone, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody kills the bird with a single stone in public again and somebody must kill the bird with a single stone before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 杀死（一般过去式 killed the bird with a single stone：1956 年工程师头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 杀死（一般现在 kills the bird with a single stone：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 杀死（不定式 to kill the bird with a single stone：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 杀死（过去完成时 had killed the bird with a single stone：1950 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 杀死（动名词 killing the bird with a single stone 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 消磨（kill an hour in the empty station：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去消磨在空荡荡的车站消磨一小时）
G. v. 消磨（kill an hour in the empty station：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 杀死（后段两处：新来的工人照例 kills an hour in the empty station，而母亲又一次 killed the bird with a single stone）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 kill 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the engineer killed the bird with a single stone before dawn, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer kills the bird with a single stone in public whenever the workshop asks.
Killing the bird with a single stone before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever kill an hour in the empty station in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop kills an hour in the empty station before dawn every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother killed the bird with a single stone again, and the workshop remembered that half.
